subject.title: feat(ui): Home page and identity-row IA for the five-zone sidebar

question: After the five-zone sidebar base lands, should the product standardize the new interaction split: Home opens the rolling main session and the identity row opens the agent menu?
rationale: This is a deliberate information-architecture and interaction-semantics change, not a mechanically determined bug fix; the protected maintainer label requires explicit ownership of that product choice.

options.title: Adopt the Home/identity split
options.body: Land this follow-up after retargeting to main once real Control UI proof confirms the intended navigation and state behavior.

options.title: Keep identity-to-chat behavior
options.body: Retain the previous identity-row conversation action and limit the follow-up to any independently desired sidebar chrome cleanup.

options.title: Pause for a single merged design pass
options.body: Defer the follow-up until the base sidebar change is reviewed on main and the resulting interaction model can be assessed together.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Home/identity split
recommendation.body: Land this follow-up after retargeting to main once real Control UI proof confirms the intended navigation and state behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as the author of both stacked sidebar design layers and the stated owner-directed design proposal.
